articles.title: A Migrating Bird's Wings Trade Speed for Sharp Turns
articles.summary: Scientists found that the nightjar's wings trade some high-speed efficiency for agility, and the bird pushes itself forward even while raising its wings.

articles.title: This Death Valley Plant Stays Cool by 'Sweating'
articles.summary: Scientists found that a Death Valley shrub survives extreme heat by releasing water vapor to cool its leaves.

articles.title: Kodak Once Kept a Special Nuclear Device in Its Basement
articles.summary: From 1975 to 2006, Kodak used a carefully controlled nuclear device in a basement to make neutrons for testing materials.
